title: Canonical transpose of the universe-lifted transition
statement:
theorem finitePerfectAdicLiftedTransition_canonical_transpose_isIso
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] {d : AdicCoefficientDatum A}
    (T : FinitePerfectAdicAlgebraTower d) (n : ℕ) :
    let q : ULift.{t + 1} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1 + 1)) →+*
        ULift.{t + 1} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) :=
      RingHom.ulift (Ideal.Quotient.factorPowSucc d.ideal (n + 1))
    letI : (normalizationModuleRestrict q).IsRightAdjoint :=
      ModuleCat.derivedRestrictScalars_isRightAdjoint.{t + 1, 0} q
    let adj := Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint (normalizationModuleRestrict q)
    IsIso ((adj.homEquiv _ _).symm (finitePerfectAdicLiftedTransition T n))

proof.text: Define the canonical left adjoint to derived restriction of scalars using the proved derived scalar adjunction. Identify the transpose of the lifted transition with the universe lift of the supplied normalized transpose, using the scalar-restriction comparison defining finitePerfectAdicLiftedTransition. The universe lift and comparison are equivalences, so they preserve invertibility.
